# Awesome Magento AEO

> A curated list of modules, specifications and tools that make a Magento 2 or Adobe Commerce store discoverable, readable and transactable by AI systems. Covers llms.txt generation, AI crawler policy, structured data, ACP product feeds, agentic checkout, MCP servers and AEO auditing.

Maintained by angeo.dev. Includes free and commercial projects from Magebit, Magenable, MaxMage, Mageworx, Webkul, Magefan, MageDelight, Amasty, Meetanshi, Mageplaza, Mirasvit, Aligent, Studio Raz, Mage-OS Lab, mage2kishan and angeo. Entries maintained by angeo.dev are disclosed in the readme.

Last reviewed 2026-08. Licensed CC0.

## Core

- [Readme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angeo-dev/awesome-magento-aeo/main/README.md): The full list, organised into eleven sections by function.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angeo-dev/awesome-magento-aeo/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Scope, inclusion criteria and entry format.

## Optional

- [Code of conduct](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angeo-dev/awesome-magento-aeo/main/code-of-conduct.md): Community standards, including the rule on competitor entries.
